sourceCommitScope: Benchmark implementation snapshot; release metadata and validation archive added by the manifest commit. 3.0.8: run_build.py gained the knowledge-blind invariant (a scored run's knowledge store is snapshotted before and after and the artifact refused if it moved); scorer bytes unchanged. run_build.py now resolves cloud entrant limits from explicit BENCH_CONTEXT_LIMIT/BENCH_MAX_TOKENS or provider metadata (google, openrouter), refuses Bedrock without them before the model is called, and records a named provider_default_unverified absence for every other provider; It also reaps, per pid, every process the finished entrant left in its session or its tree before scoring (reaped-processes.json, which bench_rescore.py excludes from the candidate inventory); test_run_build_cloud.py changed with it; scorer bytes unchanged. OpenRouter entrants receive the provider's context window only; the listed output cap is recorded, not sent (it narrowed the backend pool and removed the host's own bound, run 9e652114). run_build.py grades against a fresh vendor (2123dc5fb): after the entrant exits it stops the build vendor, keeps that traffic as vendor-build-trace.jsonl (excluded by bench_rescore.py and fix_waves_delta.py) and serves the run's own seed on the advertised port into trace.jsonl, the same procedure as the hermetic score_sb71.py CLI (run 43896353: the build session's 253 sync-1 pages, drop, 500, 28 sends and a dead webhook were graded in-app). SCORER BYTES CHANGED (4e55730b8): product_probe_sb71.mjs and product_probe_v3.mjs wait for the post-release drag sample instead of reading it at a fixed delay (identical whenever the sample has landed), and record the grading browser; score_sb71.py refuses to grade without the pinned bundled browser. Golden reference rescored with these bytes on the bundled runtime under host load ~28: earned 0.9940, inner 1.0, critical multiplier 1.0, drag rows 1.0; m_committed_event_replay 0.3333 under that load (a path this change does not touch); the pre-change scorer (bfa4dc2da) on the same host minutes later earned 0.9342 and refused on j_workflow_journey 0.8571 instead, so neither run is a clean reference at that load. The validation receipt below still describes the earlier scorer bytes; a quiet-host reference rescore is owed before the next release validation. SCORER BYTES CHANGED (056721cf0, 9e1d55e1e, 03101a984; run openrouter-cloud-01dae737 was refused fire_d1_mutation:failed in-app and by the CLI): product_probe_sb71.mjs proves in the same session when the candidate's own click/pick cannot brush the D1 target its canvas draws (exact status colour at the clicked pixel, vs7dbg.pick names something else) and then arms an unbrushed pixel witness (armed_unbrushed) or reports candidate_unreachable; score_sb71.py fires the D1 mutation for both, re-checks the proof and refuses on any contradiction, measures the stream rows (or charges p_stream_apply/e_stream_apply_latency 0 with the reason when no witness was armable), charges the documented D1 decisions corner 0, and records stream_witness in the verdict; witness_unavailable without proof, a missing readiness file and a failed vendor fire still refuse, and a viz probe that hits its hard cap before the visual observations now refuses instead of zeroing them. score_sb71.py's SSE head keeps the status and content type it received when the stream idles after its first chunk (01dae737: TimeoutError had turned a real text/event-stream into ctype ''). vendor_service_v3.py records a duplicate of an event that never reached a webhook as sched-partial duplicate_of_undelivered_original instead of raising KeyError inside the list request (01dae737 page 109). Added fixtures_sb71_witness.py (actual 01dae737 observations); test_score_sb71.py and test_sb71_visual.py changed with it. 01dae737 rescored on its own seed a435e8242e758c46, port 8850, bundled runtime: 0.699 (earned 0.7799, inner 0.9125, critical multiplier 0.8674; stream applied 179.8 ms through the unbrushed witness). Golden reference with these bytes on its own seed 5a05d7631d9276e3 under host load ~16-23 on 16 cores: 0.9940, inner 1.0, critical multiplier 1.0, reference gate passed, brushed witness, no stream_witness record. The validation receipt below still describes the earlier scorer bytes; a quiet-host reference rescore is owed before the next release validation. Merged with the provider-error ending refusal (50a31be9b): run_build.py refuses to grade a session the provider ended on a transient failure after goose's resend policy was spent. run_build.py records the provider's billed cost (d0cc819a3): for an OpenRouter entrant bench_cost.py (new) reads /api/v1/generation for every generation id the isolated runtime kept (sessions.db message ids, request logs) and writes model-cost.json and agent.billed_cost (billed_usd, native tokens, hosts, missing and late ids, and a reconciliation against goose's session token counters that marks the bill a lower bound when calls are unattributed); every other provider records a named unavailable status. bench_rescore.py excludes model-cost.json from the candidate inventory; test_bench_cost.py (new) and test_bench_rescore.py changed with it; scorer bytes unchanged. bench_cost.py reads the generation ids first from the run's .swarm/telemetry.jsonl (cd8c4f257; goose 46fe79e8c writes response_id and ended on every OpenRouter call, dropped streams included), bills dropped calls outside the token cross-check and names any telemetry call without an id; test_bench_cost.py changed with it; scorer bytes unchanged. SB7.2 (2026-10-02): bench bytes changed for the SB7.2 tier — product_probe_sb71.mjs gains the SB7.2 profile (inactive for SB7.1; the wheel step is a named constant still 400, and brushHighlight records its target facts), score_sb71.py's CLI moved into run_cli (identical behaviour), run_build.py and bench_rescore.py read isolated_tiers.py for --sb71/--sb72, new SB7.2 files are pinned. golden-sb71 rescored on the bundled runtime with these bytes: 0.994, earned 0.9940, inner 1.0, x1.0, reference gate passed (load 7.6) — identical to this manifest's validation receipt; Gemini 20940258 re-scored 0.799 with raw 0.9683, identical to its published number. Call budget and wallet guard (5ae66cd5e, owner-approved 2026-10-02): run_build.py passes --max-turns bench_budget.CALL_BUDGET (150) to every isolated single-model entrant's goose run (swarm entrants unbudgeted), records budget{max_calls, calls_used, stopped_by} in agent, verdict and model-cost.json, scores a call-budget or wallet-guard stop instead of refusing it, and with BENCH_MAX_USD set SIGTERMs an OpenRouter entrant's pid once its billed generations reach the limit; bench_budget.py and test_bench_budget.py are new, bench_cost.py and bench_rescore.py changed with it; scorer bytes unchanged. SB7.2 public contract trim (2026-10-02, f202fcaab): isolated_tiers.py gains a per-tier `public` table that run_build.py renders into the workdir; SB7.1 still renders spec-build-sb7.md and sb7.1/VISUAL-CONTRACT.md (receipt contract tuple unchanged, test-pinned); SB7.2 renders its own sb7.2/SB7-CONTRACT.md, sb7.2/VISUAL-CONTRACT.md and sb7.2/STARTER.md (72,107 -> 35,848 bytes; three refuter-found measured requirements restored: newest-first notifications, /api/events seq > after ascending, /api/drafts?state= filter) and its prompt gains a definition of done and the 150-call budget; score_sb72.py hashes the SB7.2 contract files; release_manifest.py pins the two new files. Scoring bytes (probes, thresholds, check logic) unchanged.
